title: SLA Deadline Checker
description: Computes incident age from explicit timestamps and compares it with each supplied SLA target. It identifies breached incidents without contacting an incident system.
decision: An incident is breached when its nonnegative age exceeds target_minutes. The aggregate status is breached if any incident breaches, otherwise it is within_sla.
inputs: The caller supplies a timezone-aware now timestamp and incidents with unique caller identifiers, timezone-aware started_at timestamps, and nonnegative target durations in minutes. No machine clock or severity mapping is inferred.
limitations: The checker does not account for pause windows, business hours, acknowledgements, service credits, or contractual exceptions. It reports arithmetic against supplied timestamps and does not page, escalate, or change incident state.
